output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply + value <= TOKEN_LIMIT check is bypassed if value is crafted to trigger overflow.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[msg.sender] += value; assert(c >= a); return c; in the add function can be bypassed if crafted to overflow.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value); assert(c >= a); return c; in the add function can be bypassed if crafted to overflow.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value; Approval(msg.sender, _spender, allowed[msg.sender][_spender]); in the add function can be bypassed if crafted to overflow.

The increaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = oldValue.add(_addedValue); Approval(msg.sender, _spender, allowed[msg.sender][_spender]); in the add function can be bypassed if crafted to overflow.

The decreaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The uint oldValue = allowed[msg.sender][_spender]; if (_subtractedValue > oldValue) { allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = 0; } else { allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue); } in the sub function can be bypassed if crafted to overflow.

The migrate function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[msg.sender] -= value; totalSupply -= value; totalMigrated += value; in the add function can be bypassed if crafted to overflow.

The setMigrationAgent function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The require(migrationAgent == 0); require(msg.sender == migrationMaster); in the add function can be bypassed if crafted to overflow.
The setMigrationMaster function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The require(msg.sender == migrationMaster); require(_master != 0); in the add function can be bypassed if crafted to overflow.
